text:
deploybot: starting v2 canary -> 15% at 11:23 UTC. initial probes green but mobile crash telemetry shows JSON parse errors (crash +0.7%).

emily: seeing stack: `JSON.parse` fails when clients read `resp.meta` — v2 sometimes nests meta under `response.envelope`.

rokas: do we have sample payloads?

qa-bot: sample (sanitized):
{ version:2, response: { text: "ok" }, response: { envelope: null }, x-request-id: "r-555" }

emily: the serializer can emit `null` for empty envelope on some branches. older SDKs expect top-level `meta` and crash.

ops: affected shard: ap-south shard=hera-02 runtime=v2-serializer-1.2 (recent PR #4178 touched envelope path).

pm-releasemgr: impact estimate?

qa-bot: ~180 tenants in sample; ~75% are mobile SDK <2.4.0. web unaffected.

emily: mitigation proposal: 1) pause canary advance, 2) pin hera-02 to v1-rt or cordon, 3) deploy gateway shim to synthesize `meta` for UA < redwood-sdk/2.4.0, 4) land runtime null-guard to always emit `{}` not `null`.

ops: will cordon hera-02 and shift traffic. watch v1 capacity.

deploybot: canary advance paused at 15% by operator.

rokas: I'll draft runtime hotfix PR (null-guard + unit test). ETA ~60m if CI clean.

se-liaison: SEs want list of impacted tenants for outreach.

qa-bot: samples queued: t-101, t-202, t-303. sanitized logs will be posted to the release channel.

pm-releasemgr: release notes blurb: call out v2 envelope change and SDK versions affected; add rollback contact.

emily: rollback criteria: if crash rate >0.5% org-wide for 1h or parse errors >0.5% post-pause -> full rollback v2 -> v1. Also alert on gateway shim 5xx > baseline+0.3%.

ops: action list: pause canary (done), cordon hera-02 (in progress), deploy shim (pending), runtime PR (rokas), customer comms (pm).

deploybot: operator note: will not resume canary without +ops signoff.

rokas: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4190 (draft). kicking CI.

ops: cordon complete, traffic shifted. monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rt/canary/5180000000

pm-releasemgr: sending short status update to status.redwood and emailing SEs.

emily: thanks team. keep updates here; tag @ops for signoff when ready to resume.
